title: architecture v1 projection configuration
description: Operator-owned projection settings for one project. Apply is READ-ONLY on this file: it carries no marker contract and no byte-preservation guarantee, so a machine write could silently reformat or drop hand-maintained exclusions.

project_id.description: A mismatch against the project being projected is a HARD ABORT, not a finding.

bindings.description: Participating repository bindings. Removing one is a `deconfigured` binding, retired through confirmation -- never carried forward like a transient `unavailable`.

over_cap_behavior.description: The cap binds NEW CREATION only. Existing confirmed nodes over a lowered cap are reported for an explicit operator decision; silent enforcement and silent non-enforcement are both forbidden.

exclusions.description: Binds CANDIDATE GENERATION. A new exclusion never retro-deletes a confirmed node; until confirmation it reads as excluded_but_confirmed.
